question: What is the weirdest thing you have ever discovered about a roommate?
story: My roommate was renting out our couch by the hour, and I found out from a Yelp review. Her name was Priya. Quiet, clean, paid rent early, never had people over. The perfect roommate. Except I kept coming home to strangers asleep in our living room, and she always said cousin. She has a lot of cousins, I thought. Then I searched our address because of a package problem, and a listing came up. Nap Nook. Four point eight stars. Sixty one reviews. Twelve dollars for ninety minutes, blanket included, quiet guaranteed, hosted by Priya. One review complained that the roommate walked through loudly. The roommate was me. I had a one star review inside my own apartment. So I confronted her, and she offered me forty percent. I said sixty. We ran it together for eight more months. My personal rating climbed to four point one.
